answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The vertex lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mesa is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
